text.tspan: dispatch thread turns the callback into a Job
and hands over the reply object
the policy table — one test per row
ride along on the running flow:
only when the arrival makes the running
flow pointless — never to overtake it
let it finish — or drop the arrival,
as a refresh meeting a dirty scratch does
a straight sequence of steps, not a graph
pure: no I/O, no clock, no randomness
I/O worker — here it may block
sent by whoever finished the step,
a stale listing owes the next caller a fresher one
